description: Speed-up of exp4 (user 2026-10-18): in-memory record cache and no gradient checkpointing; numerically identical training. Rigid-lid training on the rigid-lid truth (user decisions 2026-10-18: rigid lid, phi/g input, 3-hour step and 3-hour loss sampling, both objectives): Experiment one, candidate template+weighted: fine-filtered start and target, unfiltered model vorticity in Eq. 7, every interior F point weighted as Eq. 7 is written (first ring next to the walls included). One of three candidates; the owner has not chosen the objective or the wall-ring treatment. Free runs on CUDA/native (user decision 2026-10-14; the GPU controls passed the v2 device check). The dataset roots below are PLACEHOLDERS for the rigid-lid truth to be generated (round16_rigidlid_truth does not exist yet); training refuses to load until the records exist.
